---

### Install

- **Homebrew:** `brew install --cask manan-santoki/tap/openshelf`
- **Or** download **OpenShelf-VERSION.dmg** below, open it and drag **OpenShelf** onto **Applications**.

Open OpenShelf from Applications and click **Open** when macOS asks. It's signed and notarized by Apple, lives in the menu bar (the wheel icon) and updates itself. Already have OpenShelf? It offers this update by itself.

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. See the [README](https://github.com/Manan-Santoki/OpenShelf#how-to-use) for how to use it.
